tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search verified holiday rentals. Every listing shows its licence, its real town worked out from the map coordinates, and measured distances to the beach and the airport. Filter by town, dates and guests. With checkIn and checkOut, each result includes the total price of the stay (cleaning included);

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: Full listing of one stay: description, highlights, FAQ, capacity, check-in and check-out times, tourist registration number, measured distances and, with dates, the total price and availability.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Day-by-day availability, nightly price and minimum stay of one stay, for up to 93 days.

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Check that a stay is free for the given dates and guests, and return the total price (cleaning included), the cancellation policy and a direct booking link with dates and guests already filled in.
